text: dsh-restart-button 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的退出插件，会在界面右下角加入悬浮电源按钮。点击后先显示确认卡片，用户确认后，客户端向本地服务发送退出请求；服务端返回确认结果后请求 DSH 退出，页面继续检查服务是否停止应答，并显示退出结果。插件通过 profile bundle 注册服务端部分，客户端使用普通 DOM 创建按钮和提示卡片。适合希望从 Web 界面结束 DSH 服务并释放监听端口的用户。安装后需重启 dsh web；代码没有读取 API 密钥或调用外部服务。

dsh-restart-button adds a floating quit button to DSH Web. After confirmation, it asks the local service to exit and reports when it stops responding. Install it to shut down DSH from the Web interface; restart dsh web after installation. No API key is required.
想从 DSH 网页直接退出整个服务。
给 Web 界面加一个带确认步骤的关闭按钮。
How can I quit the DSH web process from its interface?
dsh-restart-button 的功能「从网页完全退出」：点击右下角的电源按钮并确认后，客户端 POST 退出路由，服务端请求 DSH 退出；页面等待服务停止应答并展示结果。
dsh-restart-button 的功能「退出状态提示」：确认退出后，页面轮询当前服务；检测到请求失败时显示已退出提示，超过等待时限则显示仍在应答的信息。

dsh-restart-button README · dsh-restart-button：A small [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that adds a floating **quit** button to the bottom-right corner of the Web GUI. (It used to restart; v0.3.0 changed it to a full exit. The package keeps its original name.)

Click it once → a themed confirm card asks if you're sure → `dsh web` fully exits and its port is released. The next launch is a cold start.

dsh-restart-button README · What it does：| | |
| --- | --- |
| Floating quit button | Pinned to the bottom-right corner, power glyph, tints red on hover |
| Confirm gate | One click → themed "完全退出 DeepSeek Harness？" card → quits only if confirmed |
| Server route | `POST /api/dsh-restart/quit` (loopback-only) |
| Quit flow | Answers the request, then asks the host to exit gracefully. **Spawns nothing.** |
| Port release | The listening socket dies with the process, so the port frees on its own |
| Result card | The page watches for the server to stop answering, then says so and how to start again |

dsh-restart-button README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-restart-button"
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The quit button appears in the bottom-right corner.

dsh-restart-button README · How it works：- **Server half** (`lib/index.js`): a cordis plugin that registers the loopback-only `POST /api/dsh-restart/quit` route. It writes the `200` first — the client renders its result card from that response, because there is no server left to ask afterwards — then calls the host's `ctx.appExit` seam.
- **Exit**: `ctx.appExit` runs DSH's own bounded shutdown — the plugin tree is disposed, then a hard exit after 5 s if disposal hangs. The plugin adds its own force-exit fallback at **8 s**, deliberately *after* that grace, so the tree always gets its turn and the fallback only catches "disposed but the event loop never drained".
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`): plain-DOM, no React, no build step. Loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`, it appends the floating button, shows the confirm card, and after confirming polls the origin until requests stop being answered — a rejected `fetch` is the only honest "it is really gone" signal available from inside the page.

dsh-restart-button README · Security：- The route is **loopback-only** (peer socket + Host header + same-origin fence), matching the DSH plugin family convention.
- Quitting spawns no process and writes no file. `scripts/check.mjs` fails the build if the host half ever grows a `spawn` again.
